name: The Senate
note: Senators returned to this room on 30 April 2024, after two years away. Everything in it — seats, desks, carpet, the acoustic walls behind the dais — is new, so a photograph taken before that date is a different chamber.

name: House of Representatives
note: Twice the Senate's room: the same refit put 644 seats and about 2,000 m² of carpet in here against 312 and about 1,000 next door. It is modelled from its own plan rather than as a recolour of the Red Chamber, and every dimension of it is derived — no floor plan of either chamber is public.
